spec.title: Pumps
spec.description: The latest value within the live window ($live_window), independent of the selected time range; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: seconds since the latest message. One row per device in the IO metadata, filtered like the trends; a device without data in the window shows –.

spec.rawSql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT mqtt_topic AS topic, max(yard_tag) AS tag,
    CASE
      WHEN max(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = '$.PositionAbs' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'valves'
      WHEN max(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = '$.CC_DutyPoint' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'pumps'
      WHEN max(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = '$.TemperatureWarm' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'rh33s'
      WHEN max(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = '$.Quantity' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'flows'
      WHEN max(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = '$.Pressure' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'pressures'
      WHEN max(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = '$.Level' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'level_sensors'
      WHEN max(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = '$.Irradiance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'pyranometers'
      WHEN max(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = '$.Temperature' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'temperatures'
    END AS kind
  FROM public.marpower__io_metadata
  WHERE mqtt_topic LIKE 'marpower/500000-thrs/%' AND yard_tag IS NOT NULL AND yard_tag <> ''
  GROUP BY mqtt_topic
), d AS (
  SELECT topic,
    last_value(speed__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS c0,
    last_value(flow__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS c1,
    last_value(pressure__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS c2,
    last_value(power_input__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS c3,
    last_value(energy_consumption__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS c4,
    last_value(op_time__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS c5,
    last_value(cc_duty_point__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS c6,
    last_value(cc_control_mode__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS c7,
    last_value(cc_on_off__value::INT ORDER BY timestamp) AS c8,
    max(timestamp) AS ts
  FROM public.marpower__thrs__pumps
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window'
  GROUP BY topic
)
SELECT split_part(m.topic, '/', 3) AS "Section",
  m.tag AS "Tag",
  split_part(m.topic, '/', 4) AS "Device",
  d.c0 AS "Speed",
  d.c1 AS "Flow",
  d.c2 AS "Pressure",
  d.c3 AS "Power input",
  d.c4 AS "Energy consumption",
  d.c5 AS "Operation time",
  d.c6 AS "Duty point",
  d.c7 AS "Control mode",
  d.c8 AS "On / Off",
  to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(d.ts) AS "Updated"
FROM m LEFT JOIN d ON d.topic = m.topic
WHERE m.kind = 'pumps'
  AND ',' || '${section:csv}' || ',' LIKE '%,' || split_part(m.topic, '/', 3) || ',%'
  AND ',' || '${device:csv}' || ',' LIKE '%,' || split_part(m.topic, '/', 4) || ',%'
ORDER BY 1, 3
